reviews.text: I’ve been sending my French bulldog there for over a year and they’ve been caring, professional and always accommodating when the need arose. It’s helped my dog socialise as well, since he’s been going since very young and it’s helped him become more social with people and other dogs. They have a great selection of items in their shop too and great add-on services. Highly recommended!

Urban Mutts and its employees provide so much care for the  fur babies they look after. Just walking in, they know the dogs by name and you can feel the love they have for the animals in their care. The facility is so large and clean. Not to mention they have the most incredible business model being able to provide all services in a one stop shop.
Leaving your beloved pets in someones care for any length of time whether it be for a grooming, daycare, or overnight can be really scary. However, I never have to worry about my dog, Gus when he is at Urban Mutts because they provide the best care.

Urban Mutts is an exceptional set up for my beloved cocker spaniel. Every aspect of this dog ‘nursery school’ is first class from the staff to the facilities and not forgetting the Grooming department who outshine anywhere else. When I’ve had to use the UM 10 star Hotel I have even had footage delivered of his sleeping and reassurance on camera that his beloved Duckie is with him. This place has real soul, an absolute one off and it’s made my dog’s London life a much happier and richer experience.
Nancy loved her first visit here. The team are really helpful and knowledgeable. Some great toys and treats available.

We have been taking Bacon to Urban Mutts for over a year now, and we honestly couldn’t be happier. Everyone is always so kind and welcoming, and they take such good care of our boy. A special mention to Saskia, who has been amazing with Bacon. Thank you Saskia!! We’re really sad she’s leaving soon... Urban Mutts has become our trusted groomer eversince Bacon came here to London from the Philippines.
UrbanMutts is excellent:  an amazing service, lovely staff (who clearly adore dogs) and an efficient operation.  Our dog goes mad every time she realises she’s going there:  she loves it!

Best place ever, the hotel, day care and grooming.
My dogs always back home very happy 😊🙏🏼

Absolutely fabulous, from the time you enter, the team are so welcoming, they answer everything , so helpful and friendly.
My Bella just loves going to play and get cuddles. Highly recommend.

A warm welcome when you step inside, all of my dog were treated like King's & Queens. They all went for a groom & came out looking like new dogs, my puppy Lab had an hours day care short notice when an emergency happened at work. She thoroughly enjoyed her time there, would recommend Urban Mutts to everyone who has dog's. Great place to get your K9 family groomed & to play with other K9's

Great place for dog daycare! The staff are incredibly friendly, welcoming and caring. My dog is always well looked after, and I feel completely comfortable leaving him in their care. Highly recommended!
The best nursery ever <3 They always take good care of my fragile little pup (special mention Aaron who makes him look so beautiful all the time)

We absolutely love Saskia! She takes such great care of our dog, Bacon, and always knows exactly the haircut we want for him. She’s so kind, gentle, and professional, and the best part is that Bacon feels completely comfortable and happy with her. It’s such a relief knowing he’s in good hands every time.
Thank you so much, Saskia!!!

As a working couple in London with a recently adopted adult dog, we cannot recommend them enough. Leo has known them for almost as long as he has known us. After 6 months of regular daycare with Urban Mutts family, he is set to have his first sleepover next week! We get all his doggie requirements done there. His grooming, his shopping, and even his medical care is managed by their in-house vet. The team genuinely loves and cares for dogs, and Leo and us are lucky to have them.

Urban Mutts is paws down the best doggy daycare everrr. Endless opportunities to play and socialise, the staff are top notch always going above and beyond. My dog always happily runs inside and oftentimes doesn't want to leave if I show up early! 😭
I appreciate the daily updates in the form of 'doggy reports' and pupdates. Whether it's for a few hours or a weekend away I know my dog will be so happy to stay and will be kept entertained. Highly recommend to any pet parent looking for a safe and enjoyable environment for their dog-child.

We've been boarding our dog, Arlo, with the Urban Mutts team for years and it's always a good experience. He used to be very anxious but never had any issues going there and, in fact, seemed very happy in all the photos and videos we got. Because they handled him so well in the beginning, we feel comfortable recommending them to everyone! Nowadays, he's a much more sociable and playful dog, and I'm sure that being exposed to other dogs under supervision at Urban Mutts was a big part of it!
Our dog loves going and runs to the entrance with excitement. Of all the places we've tried the flexibility here is the best and works with our schedule. The grooms are also top notch!
I have never experienced something so fabulous as Urban Mutts, the staff are incredible the grooming is amazing my boy Vinny cries when he has to leave.

My dog Russell absolutely loves his daycare days at Urban Mutts. He’s been going for around a year and has settled in well. The staff are always very friendly and clearly care a lot about the dogs. They take the time to write pupdates after every session which I love reading. The booking process is so easy with the new portal.
We’ve also had his nails trimmed at the in house groomers and I’ve always been impressed with this service too.
Very pleased with Urban Mutts as a whole.

While I don't normally write these much, I would be remiss if I didn't share my experience with Urban Mutts.

For over 3 years, I used Urban Mutts to take care of my dog, Lucy, and they were beyond exceptional in taking care of her.  Whether it was a simple groom or boarding when I had to travel, I never worried for a moment as they took great care of her.  Their daily pup updates were a great way to keep me informed and on the few occasions they had to reach out directly, they were always proactive and ensured Lucy's health and wellness were the priority.

I cannot recommend this company and these wonderful people enough.  Should my travels bring me back to London, they are the only folks I would trust with my four-legged family members.

Aaron was fantastic and is the best groomer by far that we have found. Yesterday was no exception, and our experience at Urban Mutts was great. Gem, our corgi, looks fabulous. Everyone is so welcoming. Highly recommend!
Thank you so much for leaving five stars, Khalil!
Not a suitable place for dogs

The best!
Thanks, Jon for being so loving, knowledgeable and accommodating

We’d used Urban Mutts's service multiple times and generally had ok experiences, which is why this incident was so disappointing and worth a read for all pet owners.👇

In April 2025, we asked about a possible wash for our dog if a slot opened up. What followed was a complete lack of communication:

-No confirmation the wash happened
-No update at pick-up
-We were charged ~£100 later without being told
-Our dog came back visibly unwashed, and we had to pay for another wash the next day

We raised this calmly at the time, but our concerns were dismissed as “process being followed,” with no acknowledgment of the communication failure.

We didn’t leave a review then and moved on in good faith.

A year later, today, when we reached out again for daycare, we were told our dog is no longer welcome. based on that same unresolved situation. This had never been clearly communicated before.

For a service built on trust and care, this experience felt unfair and surprisingly unprofessional.

Disappointing experience overall. Less about the incident itself, more about how it was handled by. no accountability, poor communication, and ultimately penalising us (and a dog! 🙄) for raising a reasonable concern.

We would encourage other pet owners to ensure clear, real-time communication on services and charges, as our experience suggests that internal processes may not prioritise that.

Urban Mutts was recommended to me and I couldn’t have been happier with the experience. I was very hesitant to leave my dog at a hotel, but everyone was extremely attentive and made sure to send me plenty of updates. JP also made sure my dog was comfortable staying at Urban Mutts before committing to a full stay. My dog had a great time and slept the whole day after picking him up.

Nothing makes my 4 month old puppy happier than going to Urban Mutts for daycare. He LOVES playing with other dogs there. He always comes home with the biggest smile on his little fluffy face and soo sleepy from a full day of learning and activities. We absolutely love JP and the team there too. Great people who are incredibly responsive and knowledgeable - and overall a a wonderful, fun place!! ❤️🐾

I bought my dog here to have his nails clipped and had no complaints .I had no appointment but they managed to see Chico.
I felt like I was in a home .Great place .Super friendly staff .

I would 100% recommend Urban Mutts to anyone looking for a daycare. Their love for the dogs is evident in everything they do.

On July 25, 2025, my dog, Beer, went to Urban Mutts. During our road trip, we wanted to spend a day in London visiting the museums and then dine at a restaurant that didn't allow dogs.

I had to search extensively beforehand for a daycare in London that would take a dog for the day, but Urban Mutts was very friendly and clear in our communication. Beforehand, I had to fill out a form asking about Beer's care and any allergies. They also asked if they could walk the dog and if the dog would be allowed to run off-leash during walks in the park—they really take everything into account.

They also wanted photos of his vaccinations so they could be sure he and all the other dogs would be safe.

Initially, I wanted Beer to stay there from 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM, but I needed to book a teaser session. This is a time for new dogs to get used to the situation. So I dropped Beer off from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM.

It took a bit of searching because they're in the Westfield Mall parking garage, but when we arrived, we were warmly welcomed. A staff member came to pick Beer up, and while he's not normally good with strangers, this lady was immediately okay.
He came along, and I was able to peek at him through a one-way window. He was a bit shy, but I could immediately see that they genuinely care about the dogs and are doing their very best.

When we picked Beer up again, he was incredibly happy and received a completed report (see photo). If that doesn't show that they truly love dogs and want to give them the best day ever, I don't know what does.

The bill arrived, and the price for the service they provided was even less than I expected.

In short, I would definitely bring Beer to Urban Mutts again if the need arises.

Thank you for your 5 stars, Cathy - it means the world to us!

~ The Urban Mutts Team

Amazing humans looking after my furry baby! We couldn’t be any happier with the hotel, daycare and all amenities. My dog’s evolution staying there, to socialize and overall behavior is fabulous. And the people are incredible humans who truly love dogs. The daily reports is extremely helpful too
Very good place

My expectations were already high, given the reviews - these were surpassed when I arranged for my two small dogs to stay with them for a weekend.  I adopted my doggies in September, and they are still developing confidence and social skills on top of dealing with whatever happened to them, so Urban Mutts was the only place I wanted to board them. I contacted them at the beginning of the week, and by Friday, we had done an afternoon of assessment and booked them in.

Urban Mutts are careful not to board dogs unless it is clear that it will be a positive experience for them, determined by the half day assessment. This initial step is indicative of what you get overall; every member of staff is a professional, and they all love dogs.

My girls had a weekend packed with planned, supervised socialisation, general health checks, development, play and cuddles. My 6 year old dog often looks sad because of what she has experienced, so you can imagine my jealousy when I got daily email updates and pictures of her smiling broadly! Most significantly, she came back much improved in her anxiety around loud sudden noises on her walks. I'm not sure what they did; I must ask them how they fixed my SugaPoohBear.

Like others who have reviewed, after just one visit, my doggies were dragging me to the entrance like huskies - that to me is the absolute measure of this place.

Thanks to all the team for giving my dogs such a nourishing experience - particular thanks to Bruce, who oversees the daily reporting and welcomes all customers in the foyer. IYKYK :-).

We'll be back, and thanks from the bottom of our hearts.

I cannot recommend Urban Mutts highly enough. We always know that our dog is in the best hands. The team is incredibly caring, professional and attentive making sure every dog feels at home and they really take the time and effort to deal with each dog and their individual needs.

What truly sets Urban Mutts apart is their warm and timely updates, knowing our dog is happy, well-fed and getting plenty of love and exercise gives me such peace of mind while away. The photos and messages they send are a delightful touch, making me feel connected even from a distance.

It's clear that everyone here genuinely loves dogs and treats each one like their own. Testament to this is the dogs arriving with excited wagging tails to get inside and play. Our dog always returns home to a good long sleep after his stay at Urban Mutts, which is evidence enough that they get plenty of exercise and play.

If you're looking for a top tier, loving dog care, look no further than Urban Mutts. I can't praise the team highly enough. They aren't the cheapest but it's worth it for the premium service and to know that our dog is in good hands. All in all it feels like good value for the level of service provided.

Leo our cuckapoo looks forward to his play time with his friends @urban mutts. We booked him for a one night stay and they were very reassuring.  Leo was well looked after. They noticed he was nervous and they kept him with a  member of the team until he settled. Highly recommend Urban Mutts hotels. They are very caring and provide the puppy's with lots of activities.  Urban Mutts hotels you are the best !!

Highly recommend!!! I wouldn’t entrust my dogs with anyone else. The Urban Mutts team is simply the best - reliable, knowledgeable, friendly, and accommodating.

I have left my dogs in their care on numerous occasions and have never been dissatisfied. My dogs are always excited when I drop them off. Facilities are safe, well maintained and spacious.

I have used Urban Mutts a large number of times and my little pooch barely looks back when she is dropped off as she is eager to meet the other dogs.  She has stayed at the hotel and also just been there for a few hours to allow me to get a few errands done.  Everytime, my 4-legged friends loves being social and running around and is also delighted to see me when I collect her.  I love receiving the pupdates and photos and everyone there just loves to be with dogs.  I will continue to use them going forwards and highly recommend.

This is the only boarding facility I trust for my dog, Yorky. The team is exceptionally attentive and kind, always going above and beyond to ensure he feels comfortable and well cared for. They provide daily "pupdates," giving me peace of mind about how he’s doing while I’m away. Yorky is 8 years old and, at times, can be a bit shy or irritable around younger dogs. The staff at Urban Mutts always makes sure he has a quiet space to retreat to when he needs it, allowing him to enjoy his time without stress. Knowing that Yorky is treated like family allows me to fully relax during my holidays!

Urban Mutts is the only place I will trust my dog, whether it’s for daycare, boarding, or grooming. They are SO attentive, both to your dog but also to your own questions/concerns as the dog owner. They go above and beyond - from accommodating any specific instructions your dog needs to pupdates, to communication, and everything in between. My dog loves it so much, he starts running toward it when we knows we’re near, and I have to LITERALLY drag him out when I pick him up. The staff are all so lovely and knowledgeable, and the facilities are spacious and clean. I highly recommend Aaron for grooming - my dog is fussy and he still works his magic on him! Urban Mutts is truly a community and safe space for you and your dog 🫶🏼

Urban Mutts is by far the best daycare and boarding facility I’ve found in London! The staff is amazing with the dogs, my dog is so excited to go that she doesn’t even need to say bye when we get in the doors, and I always know she’s safe …

Goose absolutely loves going to urban mutts. He goes weekly for day care, has been groomed there (and actually behaves!) and has stayed there for a week. The team are all lovely and really well informed. Through their support of goose he …

Wowza what an amazing place with such lovely and dedicated staff - My 5 month old puppy Willow has stayed in the hotel a couple of times, she has had an introduction to the grooming session plus attended her first adolescent puppy training …
Brilliant staff they truly care about the Dogs he’s stayed weeks at a time and for daycare no issues Thank you Urban Mutts x

Great day out for my pup, he always loves going and the team are super friendly and very attentive. The reports cards at the end of each day are a great way to see how your pup is interacting with other dogs

Pickle has been at urban mutts since she was 4 months old, she turns 2 today.
She loves being there, jumps out of the car tail wagging runs to the door and watches through the window to see who's coming. …
